unlisted_practices: Develop policy frameworks and sustainable practices so that AI-driven innovations do not exacerbate existing disparities in healthcare access and quality.
Evaluate the value of LLM chatbots in clinical practice on an ongoing basis to determine whether their costs are justified by their benefits.
Plan strategies to ensure fair access to LLMs, so that smaller and under-resourced institutions are not excluded from their benefits.
Reduce the energy, water, and CO2 footprint of LLM training and operation through renewable energy and hardware optimization.

screen.reason: Editorial discussing the economic and environmental costs, governance, and sustainability implications of implementing large language models in radiology.
